title: Work Map Autofix exact-head convergence contract

phases.objective: Keep the sole governed Work Map writer exact-head bound while preserving the registered Hostinger Spec014, Retail Spec014, and runtime-integrity Spec018 final-registry convergence and deterministically refreshing any additional producer-eligible work-map-integration binding derived from a complete exact target pull-request changed-file inventory.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The current E2E Work Map recovery bridge, Spec Kit Work Map Autofix workflow, governed generated-artifact refresh authority, canonical final Work Map binding producer, and their pipeline/automation-overlap contracts
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reviewer receives deterministic evidence only when the exact-head writer proves the resolved target PR file inventory complete before delegation, validates every discovered Work Map manifest against canonical producer eligibility, regenerates Work Maps plus the registered static and target-derived bindings under explicitly registered writer authority, proves the combined write set idempotent/current, pushes once without force, and dispatches verification for the resulting exact head.
steps: Load the current E2E Work Map recovery bridge, sole workflow-dispatch writer, registered generated-artifact refresh maintenance authority, and canonical binding producer.
Validate branch/head identity, protected-ref rejection, recovery delegation, shared concurrency, self-hosting source scope, and no-force-push boundaries.

Resolve exactly one same-repository open pull request, fetch its exact metadata, require numeric changed_files not greater than 3000, enumerate changed filenames through the GitHub pull-request files API, and require the fetched filename count to equal changed_files before consuming delegation.
Propagate target pull-request metadata, file API, authentication, pagination, over-cap, or inventory-completeness failures instead of treating them as an empty binding set.

Identify changed specs/<feature-key>/work-map-integration.json candidates, require canonical lowercase/hyphen feature-key syntax, exact manifest feature_key identity, review_state=ready_for_implementation, and file existence in the exact checked-out head before consuming the one-time delegation.
Require Automation Overlap policy, Supervisor Runtime Assurance, and generated README source to register the same producer-compatible target-derived Work Map manifest authority as the workflow.

Run Work Map generation followed by Hostinger Spec014, Retail Spec014, and runtime-integrity Spec018 static convergence plus the canonical binding producer for every additional target-derived feature key.
Restrict the candidate delta to docs/work-maps, the registered static outputs, and only target-derived integration manifests discovered and validated from that complete pull-request inventory.
Repeat the complete convergence and compare the bounded diff to prove combined idempotency.
Run Work Map currentness plus all registered static and target-derived binding checks before commit/push.

Run Pipeline Connectivity, Automation Overlap, Supervisor Runtime Assurance, generated-artifact maintenance authority, trusted evidence publisher, Work Map generator, and final-binding convergence regressions against the same repository tree.
assertions: Work Map Autofix remains the sole remote writer for docs/work-maps and does not gain a pull_request trigger.
The one-time work-map-autofix authorization marker remains outside the writer in the recovery bridge.
The writer is bound to one existing same-repository PR branch and immutable expected_head_sha; main and Production remain forbidden targets.
Target-derived binding authority comes only from the complete exact resolved pull request changed-file list and never from a caller-supplied feature key, manifest path, or arbitrary repository path.

GitHub target-PR inventory discovery is fail-closed before Recovery delegation consumption: exact PR metadata must expose numeric changed_files, changed_files above 3000 are rejected, API/authentication/pagination failures abort, and the successfully fetched filename count must equal changed_files.
Only a successfully fetched complete inventory with zero producer-eligible manifest candidates is treated as no target-derived binding work.

A target-derived binding path must match specs/[0-9]{3}-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*/work-map-integration.json, exist in the exact checked-out head, contain the same feature_key, and declare review_state=ready_for_implementation before delegation consumption.
Hostinger Spec014, Retail Spec014, and runtime-integrity Spec018 bindings remain refreshed through http-generic-api/scripts/spec014-refresh-final-work-map-binding.mjs after Work Map generation.
Every additional target-derived binding is refreshed through the same canonical producer using its prevalidated derived feature key.
The registered static Hostinger, Retail, and Spec018 keys are excluded from target-derived replay so the canonical producer is not invoked twice for the same static binding.

Automation Overlap policy, Supervisor Runtime Assurance, and generated README source register the same bounded target-derived pattern specs/[0-9][0-9][0-9]-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*/work-map-integration.json in addition to the static Work Map outputs.

The generated-artifact self-hosting source scope explicitly permits the canonical binding regression plus the Work Map generator, supervisor runbook, automation-overlap policy, and evidence publisher surfaces needed to govern this convergence; unrelated source paths remain fail-closed.
The maintenance bootstrap runs the strict final-binding regression only after Work Map generation and every governed registered binding in scope have converged and passed currentness checks.

The maintenance authority and trusted generated-artifact PR evidence publisher accept the same bounded self-hosting candidate source set, so a successful bootstrap report cannot be rejected by publisher scope drift.

The static bounded writer set remains docs/work-maps, Hostinger work-map-integration.json plus optional canonical tasks.md, Retail work-map-integration.json, and runtime-integrity Spec018 work-map-integration.json; dynamic authority can add only exact predelegation-validated manifests matching the registered producer-compatible pattern.
Combined Work Map plus final-registry binding generation is idempotent and every producer passes check mode before any commit.
The remote branch is re-read against expected_head_sha immediately before one normal push; force push remains forbidden.
Post-write CI and Spec Kit Work Map Integration are dispatched only for the resulting exact head.
The binding producer performs no provider dispatch, live database access, migration apply, Production mutation, or secret access.

phases.objective: Observe the next explicitly authorized Work Map Autofix dispatch and confirm an additional producer-eligible target-derived Spec binding converges in the same exact-head writer cycle while the registered Spec018 binding remains converged without a separate repair cycle.
